Calculate the Burgers vector magnitude for a perfect dislocation in the FCC metal with lattice parameter a = 0.404 nm.
The perfect dislocation in an FCC crystal has Burgers vector of the type a/2 <110>.
Compute the magnitude as |b| = a/√2.
Substituting a = 0.404 nm gives |b| = 0.404/√2 ≈ 0.286 nm.
Present the result with the formula and the final numerical value of approximately 0.286 nm.
